name: Fellten
source:
“Hm?”

“Who do we have here?”

“I bid you welcome, oh curious souls.”

“Here lies the tale of a lost soul in search of an answer, or even to find a place where he belongs.”

“To fulfill a lifelong resolve, He treks on, feeble his body throughout the land, sea, and snow, gambling in the hands of fate.”

“But perhaps…”

“This lost soul needn't travel alone.”

“Potential comrades, mysterious allies, and even unknown adversaries may lie ahead.”

“Afterall…”

“In this grim, yet beautiful world of Yggdrasil,”

“Trust is an expensive price to pay.”

“...”

“Well? I can tell you more about them if you want to.”

“For I toast to you, the tale of FELLTEN.”

[From [url=https://inimalt.itch.io/fellten]Itch.io[/url]]
